passages.text: As Yahweh lives, what my God says, that will I speak.
passages.note: Pressure to tell people what they want to hear; integrity

passages.text: We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.
passages.note: Helplessness and not knowing what to do; trust

passages.text: Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
passages.note: Overwhelmed by a struggle too big to carry alone
